messages:
Priya (product): FYI incoming from support: FluxHealth reporting big tail latency and occasional 429s since yesterday evening. They say throughput dropped ~30% on their dedicated pool.
Maya (support): attaching customer's summary + logs: they saw p95 jump from 120ms -> 560ms and a spike of 5xx error rate for short windows. Link to ticket: https://redwood/tickets/FLX-998 :cry:
Linh (eng-oncall): saw alert flood on prod routing layer around 19:03 UTC, rate-limited backends for a while. I deployed a quick fallback but need more context.
Karthik (eng-runtime): any recent rollout or kernel change around that time? We landed the routing fallback heuristic yesterday (rollout-142) which changes queuing for low-priority customers. Could be related to priority demotion + batching behavior.
Omar (eng-platform): routing rollout did flip 100% in eu-west-1 at 18:58 UTC. We have traces showing a queue buildup for some customers with long sequence lengths.
Priya (product): FluxHealth is on a reserved Dedicated pool and is in-trial for Private soon — this is customer-facing and they want a timeline. Product asks: is this a bug (hotfix) or a backlog prioritization for next sprint?
Karthik (eng-runtime): initial hypothesis: the new routing heuristic demotes requests that look like low-priority conversational traffic, which pushed them into a different execution path that increases kv-cache misses and reduces batching efficiency for their workload.
Maya (support): customer says their traffic shape hasn't changed. They are using embeddings + chat in mixed bursts. They only started noticing after last night.
Linh (eng-oncall): reproducing with a copy of their payload: I can trigger p95 regression locally when I enable the demotion rule. Sharing snippet:```cfg
routing.demote_threshold = 0.25
routing.policy = "demote_low_qps"
```
Karthik (eng-runtime): ok that matches. Quick mitigation options: 1) revert rollout for the Dedicated customer queue 2) whitelist FluxHealth so demotion doesn't apply 3) tune demote threshold per pool.
Omar (eng-platform): whitelisting per-customer is quick and low-risk. Revert is higher blast radius.
Priya (product): customer needs an interim SLA note. I want a short-term fix within 24-48h and a long-term spec to prevent this for other dedicated customers.
Karthik (eng-runtime): agreed. Proposed action: whitelist FluxHealth today (hotfix), create backlog story to add per-pool adaptive threshold + rollout observability (spec with launch criteria: no p95 regressions in canary for 48h, e2e tracing enabled).
Priya (product): put the spec on the roadmap: add to "Dedicated reliability" epic, priority: high, acceptance: automated canary, perf regression guardrail, docs for sales.
Linh (eng-oncall): I'll submit an incident note and set status to triaged. If we whitelist, I can monitor and confirm p95 returns to baseline.
Maya (support): told the customer we'll do a whitelist and follow up with timeline.
DeployBot: deploy started: platform-config@whitelist-fluxhealth -> eu-west-1 (ci-4567)
Karthik (eng-runtime): after whitelist goes live, we should run the FluxHealth load replay and measure batching stats (kv-cache hit rate, batch size).
Omar (eng-platform): created backlog ticket: PLAT-2108 (add per-pool demotion controls + observability). Assigned to Karthik, target sprint: next.
Priya (product): thanks all — keep updates here. If whitelist doesn't fix it within 2h escalate to rollback.
Linh (eng-oncall): monitoring now, will post results.
DeployBot: deploy succeeded: platform-config@whitelist-fluxhealth -> eu-west-1 (ci-4567)
Linh (eng-oncall): initial numbers: p95 dropped back to ~130ms within 10min of change, 5xxs cleared. Continuing to watch for an hour.
Priya (product): filing customer-facing follow-up and adding acceptance criteria to PLAT-2108: (1) per-pool toggle, (2) automated canary with perf regression alert, (3) runbook for whitelist + rollback.
Karthik (eng-runtime): I'll draft the spec tonight and share for review tomorrow.
Maya (support): letting customer know we fixed a config change; will send recap. :thumbsup:
Priya (product): good, closing triage for now. Will reopen if we see re-regression.
Linh (eng-oncall): incident note saved -> INC-2026. Last update 1h after mitigation.
